notes: Authored in this repository. There is no upstream pin and no custody table.

skills/voice/SKILL.md names 'python3 scripts/voice_cli.py <command>' as the package's command surface, and voice_cli.py is the only script that answers --help with a help action. scripts/speak.py exits 0 without output for --help, because it reads its one argument as a payload path rather than as an option. scripts/mcp_server.py ignores its arguments entirely and serves JSON-RPC on stdio, exiting 0 at end of input. An invocation stage through either would record an exit status that says nothing about a command surface, so neither is an assessment entrypoint.

The package reads no credential variable: PATH is the only environment variable its scripts read, and scripts/settings.py states that no setting may carry a secret. credential_prefixes is therefore empty and named in declared_none.

The mutating operations are the voice_cli.py subcommands that write: bind binds a Herdr agent, pane runs the pane loop, toggle starts or stops a recording and delivers it, stop halts playback, and policy brief-next-turn arms an override. preflight and policy show only probe and report.
